note: College football price screen (output/research/cfb/price_screen.json; rules P1 and P2 passed, P3 too few bets, P4 failed). Two sub-rules share one ledger, one bet per game per sub-rule. P1 soft-vs-Pinnacle: 472 bets 2021-25, CLV +2.2% vs the Pinnacle no-vig close (p<0.0001), 5/5 seasons positive, ROI +1.5% +- 6.6%. P2 moneyline vs Pinnacle spread: 855 bets, CLV +1.8% (p<0.0001), 5/5 seasons, ROI +6.8% +- 4.9%; 2026 to date +2.2% CLV on 42 bets. WARNING: CLV shrank from ~2.5-3.7% (2021-23) to 0.2-0.9% (2024-25). Live snapshots are hourly Thu-Sat (research snapshots were 2-6 per day), so live prices are fresher than in the research. Do not edit to fit results; bump the version.

qualify.P1: your best moneyline beats the Pinnacle no-vig win probability by EV >= 2%
qualify.P2: your best moneyline beats the Pinnacle-SPREAD-implied win probability (normal, sd 15.7, juice-adjusted) by EV >= 2% AND has EV >= 0 vs Pinnacle's own moneyline

grading.clv: decimal price x Pinnacle no-vig win probability in our last NCAAF snapshot before kickoff - 1
